```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

#qc_data
```{r}
data("processed_data")
qc_data(processed_data)
```

#plot_latest_timepoint
```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
plot_latest_timepoint(processed_data)
```

#annotate_chemical
```{r}
data("PM_M01_M02")
processed_data <- annotate_chemical(processed_data, annotation = PM_M01_M02)
head(processed_data$data)
```

#classify_growth_curve_types
```{r}
processed_data <- classify_growth_curve_types(processed_data)
head(processed_data$classification)
```

#plot_growth_curve
```{r, fig.width=15, fig.height=7}
processed_data <- plot_growth_curve(processed_data)
print(processed_data[["growth_curve_plots"]])
```

#(optional)filter_data
```{r}
processed_data <- filter_data(processed_data, plate_type = "PM-M01")
```

#compute_auc_ci
```{r}
processed_data <- compute_auc_ci(processed_data)
head(processed_data$auc_results)
```


#plot_controls_tween_per_plate
```{r}
plot_controls_tween_per_plate(processed_data, selected_plate = "PM-M01")
```

#plot_controls_tween_all_plate
```{r}
plot_controls_tween_all_plate(processed_data)
```

#plot_auc
```{r,fig.width=15, fig.height=20}
plot_auc(processed_data, selected_plate = "PM-M01", facet_vars = c("radiation.dose","inhibitor"))
```

#compute_auc_ratio
```{r}
processed_data <- compute_auc_ratio(processed_data)
head(processed_data$auc_ratio)
```

#annotate_metadata
```{r}
processed_data <- annotate_metadata(processed_data, annotation = PM_M01_M02)
```

#plot_auc_ratio_heatmap
```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=12}
plot_auc_ratio_heatmap(processed_data, 
                       plate_type = "PM-M01", 
                       x_var = "radiation.dose")
```

#plot_auc_ratio_by_pathway
```{r}
plot_auc_ratio_by_pathway(processed_data, 
                          pathway_var = "middle_hierarchy", 
                          x_var = "radiation.dose", 
                          pathway_filter = "Nucleotide metabolism")
```

#plot_auc_ratio_violin
```{r}
plot_auc_ratio_violin(processed_data, 
                      pathway_var = "middle_hierarchy", 
                      pathway_filter = "Nucleotide metabolism", 
                      color_var = "radiation.dose")
```
